name: Steelsnap's Rib
summary: In Thousand Needles, Steelsnap's Rib carries proof of a feared hyena’s end. Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff wants it brought to Hunter Rise to show that Steelsnap has been slain.

sections.title: A Hunt Outside the Blessing
sections.body:
Tauren hunts often seek food, honor, or harmony with nature. Steelsnap is another matter. The alpha hyena roams the canyon floor south of Camp E'thok in Thousand Needles. He terrorizes peaceful wildlife and rallies lesser predators to bloodshed.

Hunt master Melor Stonehoof waits on Hunter Rise. He marks Steelsnap for death and asks for the hyena's rib as proof. With Steelsnap slain, the canyon can be cleansed of his blight.

faq.q: What is Steelsnap's Rib used for?
aliases: what do i do with steelsnaps rib
faq.answer: Bring Steelsnap's Rib to Melor Stonehoof on Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff. The bone proves Steelsnap has been defeated.

faq.q: Where can I find Steelsnap to get the rib?
faq.answer: Steelsnap roams the canyon floor in northwestern Thousand Needles, south of Camp E'thok. Loyal packmates often flank him.

faq.q: Why does Melor Stonehoof want Steelsnap killed?
faq.answer: Melor considers Steelsnap an unnatural tyrant outside the Earthmother's blessing. The hyena spreads bloodshed and fear among peaceful beasts, unlike predators that hunt to survive.
Melor Stonehoof is a veteran tauren hunter on Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff. He sends aspiring trackers after dangerous beasts across Kalimdor.

angles.text: As a hunter, tracking Steelsnap tests your skill against a dangerous pack leader. It also helps cull a threat to the wild's balance.
As a tauren, bringing back Steelsnap's Rib fulfills your duty to the Earthmother. You purge a cruel creature that taints the sacred balance.
